dedupe_keys.name: ihm stefanini industrial safety and health incidents

description: IHM Stefanini publishes accident records from twelve industrial plants in three anonymised countries. The table documents incident date, plant context, actual and potential accident severity, worker category, critical risk and a narrative description. Severity uses ordered categories, not a common physical damage unit. The manifest lists two CSV files and an illustration. Kaggle offers the collection freely under CC0. Exact observation years, countries, exposure hours and row count are not stated in the inspected description. A limitation is that recorded incidents without workforce or operating-time denominators cannot establish comparable accident rates across plants. Simulation uses include defining industrial safety event types and severity scenarios after reviewing reporting differences. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with human-safety outcomes, not component wear traces. Only public metadata were read; individual incident narratives and personal details were not inspected or copied.
